battle_traits.name: Thorgrim's Beard! There Are Grudges to Be Settled!
battle_traits.effect:
If your general was destroyed this turn, you can give up to 3 friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units 1 grudge mark.
Otherwise, pick up to 3 of the following effects:
• If any friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units were destroyed this turn, give 1 grudge mark to a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit.
• If any friendly KROMDRON units are contesting an objective that is being contested by any enemy units, give 1 grudge mark to a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit.
• If any friendly GRIMMDRON units charged this turn, are in combat, have not been destroyed and did not destroy an enemy unit this turn, give 1 grudge mark to a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit.
• If any damage points were allocated to your general this turn, give 1 grudge mark to a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit that is not your general.

battle_traits.name: Reclaim the Karaks
battle_traits.effect:
Immediately after your opponent gains control of an objective within your territory, you can give 1 grudge mark to a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit.
Each time a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit uses the 'Retreat' ability, after that ability has been resolved, you must remove 1 grudge mark from that unit (if it has one).

battle_traits.name: Let It Be Known!
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS HERO to use this ability, then pick a visible friendly non-HERO KHAZALITE HOLDS unit wholly within 12" of that HERO to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has 1 additional grudge mark.

battle_traits.name: Gazul, Remember the Fallen!
battle_traits.effect: While at least half the models in a DUARDIN KHAZALITE HOLDS unit have been slain, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: Models that have been slain and returned to the unit do not count as having been slain for the purposes of this ability.

battle_traits.name: We Honour Valaya!
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly DUARDIN KHAZALITE HOLDS units in combat to be blessed by Valaya. Then, for each unit blessed by Valaya this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be its target.
battle_traits.effect:
Roll a D3 for each unit blessed by Valaya this turn. If that unit is VALAYAN, use a value of 3 instead. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on its target equal to the roll. Then, you can pick 1 of the following:
• Heal (X) the unit blessed by Valaya, where X is equal to the value of the roll.
• Return a number of slain models to the unit blessed by Valaya with a combined Health characteristic of up to the value of the roll.
You cannot use any other ANCESTRAL VOW abilities for the rest of the battle round.

battle_traits.name: Inghilde, Our Light in the Darkness
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly non-HERO KHAZALITE HOLDS INFANTRY unit and up to 1 friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS INFANTRY HERO that are wholly within 6" of the same terrain feature and not in combat to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect:
Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 6" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. If there are 2 targets, you must set them up within 3" of each other.
You cannot use any other ANCESTRAL VOW abilities for the rest of the battle round.

battle_traits.name: By Grungni, Stand Firm!
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly DUARDIN KHAZALITE HOLDS units to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, while a target has not used a CHARGE ability this battle round, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target that unit.
You cannot use any other ANCESTRAL VOW abilities for the rest of the battle round.

battle_traits.name: Grimnir's Wrath Will Burn Bright!
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly DUARDIN KHAZALITE HOLDS units to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round:
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the targets' combat attacks.
• If a target has the INFANTRY and GRIMMDRON keywords, it has STRIKE-FIRST if it charged in the same turn.
You cannot use any other ANCESTRAL VOW abilities for the rest of the battle round.

battle_traits.name: Enlighten Us with Your Wisdom, Grombrindal!
battle_traits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round:
• Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units.
• While they are wholly within 12" of a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD or PRIEST, friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units have WARD (4+) against damage points inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.
You cannot use any other ANCESTRAL VOW abilities for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Bellicose Belligerents
abilities.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units.

abilities.name: Lock Shields!
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units while they are wholly within friendly territory or while every model in the unit is contesting an objective you control.

abilities.name: Stalwart Resolve
abilities.effect: While an enemy unit is in combat with a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit, subtract 1 from the number of inches that enemy unit can move when it makes a pile in move, to a minimum of 1".

abilities.name: Well-travelled Roamers
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a RUN or CHARGE ability for a KHAZALITE HOLDS unit
abilities.effect: If that unit is more than 6" from all other friendly units, you can re-roll the dice that determines how far it can move.

entries.name: Hearthflares
entries.declare: Pick an objective within 12" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 5 to the control scores of friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units while they are contesting the target.

entries.name: Flamescale Rune Cloak
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit if it has not charged this turn.

entries.name: Deep-earth Runic Weapon
entries.declare: Pick 1 of this unit's non-Companion melee weapons to be the runic weapon. This unit can use this ability even if it is in reserve.
entries.effect:
Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the runic weapon for the rest of the battle. Then, pick 1 of the following:
Strike a Rune: Roll a dice. On a 3+, also add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the runic weapon for the rest of the battle.
Repeatedly Strike a Rune: Roll a dice. On a 5+, also add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and Damage characteristic of the runic weapon for the rest of the battle.

entries.name: Long of Beard or Braid
entries.effect: Each time a visible friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

entries.name: Innate Resonance
entries.effect: If this unit is not a PRIEST, it has WIZARD (1). If this unit already has WIZARD (1), it has WIZARD (2) instead. In addition, enemy MANIFESTATIONS have STRIKE-LAST while they are within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Sworn to Vengeance
entries.effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by attacks made with this unit's non-Companion weapons this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, give this unit a vengeance token, to a maximum of 3. Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's non-Companion melee weapons for each vengeance token it has.

entries.name: Aureate Hide
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
entries.effect: After that FIGHT ability has been resolved, if any enemy models were slain by that FIGHT ability, you can pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST wholly within 12" of this unit. Give that PRIEST D3 ritual points.

entries.name: Intense Fyrestream
entries.effect:
Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Add X" to the Range characteristic and X to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Companion ranged weapons, where X is equal to your fury level.
• This unit's Companion ranged weapons have Shoot in Combat.

entries.name: Thickened Scales
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

entries.name: Rune of Dismay
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are within 6" of the caster.

entries.name: Rune of Courage
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

entries.name: Rune of the Furnace
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible enemy unit within 12" of the caster.

entries.name: Rune of Might
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units while they are within 3" of the caster.

entries.name: Rune of Sanctuary
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while they are wholly within 12" of the caster, friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.

entries.name: Rune of Warding
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while they are within 12" of the caster, attacks made by enemy units cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

entries.name: Recitation to Valaya
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target those friendly units until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Recitation to Gazul
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, enemy units and enemy MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up within 12" of the chanter. If the chanting roll was 9+, enemy units and enemy MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up within 18" of the chanter instead.

entries.name: Recitation to Grimnir
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a CORE ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target or, if the chanting roll was 10+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target instead.

entries.name: Fury of Vulcatrix
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks, including those made with Companion weapons, until the start of your next turn.
In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Ichor of the Ur-Salamander
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
• If the target is a MAGMADROTH, each time its 'Volcanic Blood' ability would inflict 1 mortal damage on an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage instead.
• If the target is a non‑MAGMADROTH unit, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets that unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: Blazing Impetus
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS unit that was not set up this turn and that is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Each target can use the 'Normal Move' or 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.
